import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for the event details. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title} - Invitation

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str) -> str: """ Create a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The title or heading of the event. e_description : str A detailed description of the event. May contain newlines or formatting. e_date : str The date on which the event is scheduled. e_notes : str Any additional information or instructions. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format the invitation using the template. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
